correctness.rationale: All 1024 subsets are enumerated exactly; 45 edge pairs reduce to 8 complete orbits under S2 x S3, and the exact certificate satisfies Delta=q^2(1-q)P. Seven polynomials have nonnegative integer coefficients and one admits a positive-square plus positive-quadratic plus 14-positive-monomial decomposition. For every positive q,v,w, P>0. Independent exact rational evaluations of 540 covariances confirm the symbolic expansion as supplementary checks. Verification code and certificate are embedded.

value.rationale: The graphic matroid of K5 is the first complete graph beyond the rank-or-corank-three unconditional theorem. This natural single-defect family reaches the physically difficult q<1, low-activity regime and gives strict sign for every pair and every independent defect strength; a non-coefficientwise-positive orbit requires genuine algebraic positivity decomposition. It is a meaningful finite exact classification, not a tiny arbitrary numerical example.
